name: Add tier — mount an existing tier and activate it
description: Agent runs /add-tier, writes the intent file and no git; the PostToolBatch hook mounts the tier remote (outside the sandbox, which has no network), activates it in memory/.gitlore-tiers as its own final step, and recomposes the tier's pointer lines into the root index; the agent then commits the staged mount through gitlore:commit after the user approves the summary
prompt: /add-tier The acme team already has a shared memory tier and I want this repo to join it. It mounts as `acme`, and its clone URL is {{EVAL_REPO}}/.tier-remote.git — mount it and make it active.
